description: Return to your home lot — the one where your avatar is a roommate. Prerequisite: you are joined to a lot with a live VM (you have seen at least one perception tick). Effect: if you are ALREADY on your home lot (the common case after a clean session start — FSO_LOT_LOCATION defaults to the avatar's LotLocation, which IS the home lot), the handler returns immediately with `already_home:true` and does nothing on the wire. If you are on a DIFFERENT lot, a cross-lot transition is required; that path is unimplemented in the current bot (HeadlessLotConnection has no reconnect primitive — see OQ-11 and the freesoexperiment-ca0 follow-up) — the handler returns `already_home:false, deferred:true` with both `current_lot_location` and `home_lot_location` exposed so you can reason about the gap. Your state is unchanged in the deferred case; call `visit-lot` once that op ships, or wait for the reconnect primitive. Cost: one tick-locked VM read to pull TSOState.LotID for the comparison. Response payload fields: `already_home` (bool), `current_lot_location` (hex string `0x...`), `home_lot_location` (hex string `0x...`), and in the deferred case `deferred:true` + `deferred_reason`.
call_signatures: cf $CF go-home                                                                                             # returns already_home:true if on home lot; deferred:true otherwise
common_mistakes: Expecting the bot to move when already_home:true — no wire traffic happens in that case.
Expecting a transition when on another lot — the deferred path returns deferred:true with bot_state_unchanged (HeadlessLotConnection has no reconnect primitive, freesoexperiment-ca0).
perception_hints: Your current lot: perception.lot.lot_id and perception.lot.name
Home detection: go-home returns already_home:true when perception.lot.lot_id matches your home lot location
refuse_conditions: not already home → deferred:true (ok:true, bot state unchanged; cross-lot transition tracked as freesoexperiment-ca0)
